name: Nisargadhama Virajpet
description: A beautiful island formed by the river Kaveri, featuring bamboo groves, deer park, and hanging bridges amidst lush greenery.

name: Abbey Falls
description: A stunning waterfall surrounded by coffee plantations and spice estates, offering a refreshing experience in the Western Ghats.

name: Tadiandamol Peak
description: The highest peak in Coorg, perfect for trekking enthusiasts seeking panoramic views of the misty hills and valleys.

name: Bhagamandala Temple
description: A sacred confluence of three rivers with a historic temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, attracting pilgrims and history lovers alike.

name: Raja's Seat
description: A scenic viewpoint offering breathtaking sunset views over the valley, once a favorite spot of the Kodagu kings.

name: Coffee Plantation Tour
description: Experience the aroma and process of coffee making by touring local plantations and interacting with farmers.

name: Chelavara Falls
description: A hidden gem waterfall surrounded by dense forest, ideal for nature lovers and photographers.

name: Nalknad Palace
description: An ancient palace showcasing traditional Kodava architecture and royal history.

name: Iruppu Falls
description: A majestic waterfall located in the Brahmagiri hills, surrounded by dense forests and a sacred temple nearby.

name: Pushpagiri Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A protected forest area rich in biodiversity, home to rare species of flora and fauna, perfect for wildlife enthusiasts.

name: Madikeri Fort
description: A historic fort with a museum inside, offering insights into the region's colonial and royal past.

name: Omkareshwara Temple
description: A unique temple blending Gothic and Islamic styles, dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in the heart of Madikeri.

name: Chelavara Coffee Estate Homestay
description: A chance to experience authentic Kodava hospitality and lifestyle amidst sprawling coffee plantations.

name: Kaveri Nisargadhama Bamboo Bridge
description: A scenic bamboo bridge connecting the island to the mainland, offering a unique walking experience over the river.

name: Chelavara Waterfalls Trek
description: A moderately challenging trek through coffee estates and forests leading to the serene Chelavara Falls.

name: Kutta Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A lesser-known sanctuary offering sightings of elephants, deer, and exotic birds in their natural habitat.

name: Kodava Cuisine Experience
description: Savor traditional Kodava dishes prepared with local spices and ingredients in a homely setting.

name: Chelavara Spice Plantation
description: Explore aromatic spice gardens growing pepper, cardamom, and vanilla with guided tours explaining their uses.

name: Brahmagiri Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A sanctuary rich in biodiversity, home to rare flora and fauna, ideal for trekking and bird watching.

name: Virajpet Market
description: A bustling local market where visitors can shop for fresh produce, spices, and traditional Kodava handicrafts.
